name: time_add
title: Civil addition through zoneinfo. A skipped hour uses the post-transition offset when roll_dst is post.

origin.description: Civil addition through zoneinfo. A skipped hour uses the post-transition offset when roll_dst is post.
origin.details: Civil addition through zoneinfo. A skipped hour uses the post-transition offset when roll_dst is post.
origin.example:
x <- as.POSIXct("2010-03-14 01:02:03", tz = "America/New_York")
print(unclass(time_add(x, hours = 1, minutes = 50, roll_dst = "post")))

translation.description: Civil addition through zoneinfo. A skipped hour uses the post-transition offset when roll_dst is post.
translation.details: Civil addition through zoneinfo. A skipped hour uses the post-transition offset when roll_dst is post.
translation.example:
x = Posixct(1268546523, "America/New_York")
print(float(time_add(x, hour=1, minute=50, roll_dst="post").seconds))
